seoTitle: Connect Stripe to Squarespace for Payments (2026)
metaDescription: Link your Stripe account to Squarespace so your store can process payments securely, with a smooth checkout for customers.
intro: Integrating Stripe with Squarespace gives your store a reliable way to process payments and improve customer checkout experience. This guide covers finding the payment settings and authorizing the connection between your Stripe and Squarespace accounts.

steps.heading: Log in to Squarespace
steps.body: Sign in to your account and select the website where you want to enable Stripe payments.

steps.heading: Open Selling and Payments
steps.body: In the site menu, go to Settings, then Selling, then Payments to see your available payment method options.

steps.heading: Choose Stripe
steps.body: Click Stripe from the payments page to begin the setup process for connecting your accounts.

steps.heading: Log in and authorize
steps.body: Sign in with your existing Stripe credentials, using the account you intend to manage transactions through, and complete the authorization prompt.

steps.heading: Confirm the connection
steps.body: Once authorized, Stripe is linked to your Squarespace store and ready to process customer payments at checkout.

faq.question: Do I need an existing Stripe account?
faq.answer: You can log in with an existing account, or you'll be prompted to create one if you don't have one yet.

faq.question: What does the authorization step actually do?
faq.answer: It grants Squarespace permission to manage payments on your behalf through your connected Stripe account.

faq.question: Is Stripe the only payment option in Squarespace?
faq.answer: No, it's one of several options found under Settings, Selling, Payments, alongside other processors you can enable.

faq.question: Who do I contact if I run into issues connecting Stripe?
faq.answer: Both Squarespace and Stripe offer support resources to help troubleshoot connection or payment issues.
